A '''power fence''' was a form of energized perimeter barrier powered by a [[power fence generator]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Kalist Base|Kalist VI labor colony]] had at least two perimeter power fences.

Power fences were used to protect remote installations such as [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. They were part of a system that worked alongside security lighting and [[Alarm system/Legends|alarm]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=2X-3KPR}}</ref>
